reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a finding that raises no negotiation issue.

The document contains no audit, inspection or verification right running against the Customer; the cited paragraphs (Section 3 restrictions ending at limb (g); Section 14 confidentiality definition) are consistent with that, and the only examination right cited (Section 16 escrow) runs in our favour.

Absence of a Vendor audit right is better than the preferred position on frequency, notice, cost and system access, so no edit is warranted — proposing audit language would create exposure the Customer does not currently have (correctly not flagged as a deviation or missing clause).
The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is an expected artefact of there being no audit clause to constrain, not evidence of a defect in the finding.
